description: This risk arises when an agent operating a computer interface accesses websites or applications that contain personally identifiable or sensitive information, particularly when authenticated as a user or organisation. As a result, the agent may inadvertently view, process, or disclose confidential data beyond its intended scope or authorisation.

controls.statement: Implement output guardrails to detect and redact personally identifiable information
Ensure "take over" mode is activated when entering sensitive data
Enforce default-deny network egress for agent runtimes, allowing only approved destinations
Do not give one agent untrusted content, access to sensitive data, and an unrestricted outbound channel at once; remove one, or gate the outbound channel outside the agent
